content.hook_text: What 'seek first the kingdom' actually means
content.verse_text: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.
content.misconception: If I do enough Christian things, God will give me what I want.
content.actual_meaning: Jesus is saying reorder your priorities — stop obsessing over provision and start obsessing over God's presence. 'All these things' (food, clothing, tomorrow) aren't rewards for good behavior; they're byproducts of a life anchored in Him. The kingdom isn't a checklist — it's a King.
content.caption:
Ever heard 'seek first the kingdom' used like a prosperity formula? Let's talk about what Jesus actually meant.

This verse isn't a transaction — it's an invitation to reorient your entire life around God's presence and purpose. When we stop treating faith as a means to an end, we find that everything else falls into its proper place.

What's one area of your life that needs reordered priorities? 🙏
